PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Safety on Raised Platforms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety on Raised Platforms.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety on Raised Platforms.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Safety on Raised Platforms.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety on Raised Platforms.

3. When learning Holding Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
